subject.title: [Feature]: Sessions page: roster overview tiles, kind avatars, and context-usage meters

question: Should maintainers accept the Sessions page redesign direction through the linked open PR, narrow it, or reject the redesign for now?
rationale: This is a user-facing Control UI redesign with a protected maintainer label and an open implementation PR, so automation should not decide the product/UX direction by closing or duplicating the work.

options.title: Review Linked PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102523 as the canonical implementation path and decide merge readiness there.

options.title: Narrow The Redesign
options.body: Ask the PR to keep only the most valuable operator telemetry changes if the full visual redesign is too broad.

options.title: Close As Not Planned
options.body: Close both the issue and linked PR only if maintainers do not want this Sessions page direction in core.

recommendation.title: Review Linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102523 as the canonical implementation path and decide merge readiness there.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the request and linked implementation PR and are the clearest product/design sponsor in the available evidence.
